reason: Short-selling-only method with no long-side rules for US stocks.

universe.description: small-cap US stocks with dilution agenda

setup.rule: identify dilution via SEC filings and shelf offerings
setup.quote: I got really good at reading SEC filings for small caps

entry.rule: enter short near high of day expecting fade
entry.quote: start in as at a likely level that I had from just my data

stop.rule: cut after three failed attempts or structure break
stop.quote: I usually have a stop at three times

exits.rule: cover at average low-of-day or structure target
exits.quote: driven by the average move I can expect from the open until the low

sizing.rule: pyramid adds on fade to align average with structure
sizing.quote: I would add to my position and add just enough size so that my average would align with prior structure

ambiguities.issue: mentions mid-cap and big-cap long swings
ambiguities.assumption: these are secondary and not the main 2020 method
